prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1065; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for giving us a few minutes today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in while driving in Houston, Texas. Is it all right if we proceed?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please describe what you were doing right before the impact.

A: I was on a multi-lane road heading toward the on-ramp. I checked my mirror, signaled, and started moving into the lane on my left because traffic in my lane was slowing down.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: Not clearly. I glanced at the mirror and didn't notice anything right beside me. Then I heard a loud scrape and felt my car jerk toward the right.

Q: Where did the two vehicles make contact?

A: Their vehicle came up on my right side, near the rear passenger door and rear wheel area. My driver's side mirror was knocked off, and the paint along that side was scraped.

Q: Did you stop at the scene?

A: Yes, I pulled onto the shoulder. I was dizzy and my head hurt quite a bit, so I stayed in the car until help arrived.

Q: Were you taken for medical care?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the hospital. They told me I had a concussion. I've been having headaches, sensitivity to light, and trouble concentrating at work.

Q: Have you been seen by a doctor since then?

A: Yes, I have a follow-up appointment scheduled and I'm trying to rest as instructed.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm sorry the other driver's path wasn't clearer to me. I want to cooperate fully.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
